content.short: Unergy funds large-scale clean energy assets to combat climate change.
content.description: The Unergy Protocol channels investment toward the development of large-scale clean energy generation assets to address climate change. It seeks to build a financial ecosystem focused on climate issues, designed to amplify humanity's impact in solving the climate crisis. By aligning capital with environmental objectives and supporting scalable energy projects, Unergy aims to accelerate the deployment of sustainable power and create lasting, climate-positive outcomes.
